item.text:
The repeated pattern is visual classes managed outside React: five components use the delayed helper, and `ViewToggle` removes its highlight in an effect. The Compact implementation copied that pattern from the code and contributing guide.

I’ll derive those classes during render, delete the helper, and remove the misleading guidance. Synchronous behavior tests will cover the correction, including the missing view highlight.
